standard_prerequisites.use: Moves the vanishing of the finitely many generators to a later stage of the system.

core_obligations: Express the first Tor group of a stage against its residue field as the kernel of multiplication on the stage and note that it is a finitely generated module over a Noetherian ring (proof lines 32948-32956).

Use flatness of the colimit module to kill that kernel in the limit, descend the finitely many generators to a later stage by commutation with colimits, and apply the local flatness criterion at that stage (proof lines 32957-32978).
proof_roadmap: Reinterpret the obstruction as a finitely generated Tor module (proof lines 32948-32956).
Descend the vanishing and apply the local criterion (proof lines 32957-32979).
difficulty_reason: Given a colimit presentation of a local ring map and of a module, the lemma states that if the colimit module is flat then some single stage is already flat (statement lines 32939-32946). The proof does not estimate flatness directly: it rewrites the relevant Tor group as a kernel of multiplication, notes that it is finitely generated, uses flatness of the colimit to make those finitely many generators vanish in the limit, descends that vanishing to a later stage by commutation with colimits, and concludes with the local criterion for flatness (proof lines 32948-32979). Reducing the obstruction to finitely many elements is the step that makes the descent possible. H2.
